def comps(i, mask_fn, min_size=40, ds=2):
    img=bpy.data.images[f'render_{i:04d}.png']; w,h=img.size

    H,W=m.shape
    visited=np.zeros_like(m)
    out=[]
    coords=np.argwhere(m)
    for sy,sx in coords:
        if visited[sy,sx]: continue
        q=deque([(sy,sx)]); visited[sy,sx]=True
        n=0; x0=x1=sx; y0=y1=sy
        while q:
            y,x=q.popleft(); n+=1
            if x<x0:x0=x
